name: Osananajimi
source:
Protagonist is enjoying his school life with his female childhood friend and school buddies. He has a "slave" sex friend who calls him "master", but there are also many other women around him. Who will he choose?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与他的儿时女性朋友和学伙伴一起享受他的学校生活。他有一个“奴隶”性朋友，称他为“主人”，但他身边还有很多其他女人。他会选择谁？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
